description: Election Commission - Notify the name of the H. S. Geethadewa as  a member of the Meerigama P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mirigama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of a new member to fill a seat vacated by resignation, which falls under election-related administrative matters.
